name: stage3_vol_proxy_vs_18d_mismatch_analysis
question: Why Stage3 causal-val vol_calibration_ratio ~0.93 (over-vol) under production decode T=0.65/top_p=0.8/N=5, while sealed 18d production OOS reports ~2.10 (under-vol) with the same decode lock on C2 best?

stage3_prod_smoke_baseline.interpretation: ratio<1 => predicted path vol HIGHER than realized (over-vol)

stage3_vol_cal_topk16_baseline.note: T=1 top-16 teacher-forced mixture; also over-vol; same realized

c2_18d_prod_t065_p80_n5.interpretation: ratio>1 => predicted path vol LOWER than realized (under-vol)

c2_18d_rank_t060_p90_n16_diagnostic.note: still under-vol; N=16 does not flip direction

formulas.direction: BOTH surfaces use realized/predicted (ratio<1 over-vol, ratio>1 under-vol). Neither flips by inverting the ratio.

stage3_causal_val.vol_calibration_ratio: mean_i( realized_path_vol_i / pred_path_vol_i )  [batch-size-weighted average of per-batch means in evaluate(); equivalent to pooled E[R/P]]
stage3_causal_val.pred_path_vol: expected_path_vol = sum_n w_n * std_H(daily_returns(candidate_n)); w_n = softmax(joint_logp) averaged over horizons then renorm
stage3_causal_val.uniform_path_vol: mean_n std_H(daily_returns(candidate_n))  [logged only; NOT the training target]
stage3_causal_val.mixture_mean_path_vol: std_H(daily_returns(sum_n w_n * candidate_n)) = vol(E[path]); explicitly NOT trained
stage3_causal_val.daily_returns: from cumulative close/last_close-1 via (1+c_t)/(1+c_{t-1})-1; std unbiased=False (ddof=0)
stage3_causal_val.denormalize: close_px = close_z * std_close + mean_close (window feature mean/std)
code: finetune/stage3_training_model.py forward: teacher-forced logits1=predict_s1(context[:,start:end]) then compute_vol_alignment_loss

oos_18d_production.calibration_ratio_realized_over_predicte: np.mean(realized / predicted) over sealed samples with both >0  [= E[R/P]]
oos_18d_production.predicted_path_vol_per_sample: mean_n std_H(daily_returns of free-AR sample path n)  [= uniform E_n[std(path_n)]]
oos_18d_production.daily_returns: to_daily(cumulative) identical algebra to Stage3 daily_returns_from_close
oos_18d_production.denormalize: paths = z * std + mean; last_close from lookback-1 denorm; same close feature
oos_18d_production.aggregation_note: summary also reports mean_predicted_path_vol and mean_realized_path_vol; calibration uses mean of ratios NOT ratio of means (E[R/P]=2.10 vs E[R]/E[P]=1.79; direction unchanged)

path_vol_definition.stage3: E_n[std(daily close returns of path n)] after denorm

decode_mechanism.stage3: TEACHER-FORCED parallel joint mixture: production_style_mixture_decode on causal teacher-forced s1 logits over all H; support_k=16 then top N=5 joint candidates PER HORIZON independently; stitch candidate-index n across H into a pseudo-path; mixture softmax weights
decode_mechanism.oos18d: FREE autoregressive sampling: N=5 coherent trajectories via auto_regressive_inference; multinomial sample each step; uniform mean over samples

path_coherence.stage3: pseudo-paths: horizon-t candidate n is independently ranked top-n at t (not a true AR trajectory) => artificially jumpy day-to-day returns => HIGH path vol
path_coherence.oos18d: true AR trajectories under concentrated T/top_p => smoother / mode-seeking => LOW path vol

temperature_application.stage3: apply_temperature_nucleus on s1 and s2_cond at T; joint ranking then nucleus at T=1.0/top_p; deterministic top-N not multinomial
temperature_application.oos18d: sample_from_logits divides by T then top_p filter then multinomial each AR step

stop_grad.stage3_train: tokenizer decode values stop-grad; grads through mixture weights only (eval is no_grad anyway)

population.note: realized vols nearly identical; the ~2.04x gap is almost entirely on the PREDICTED side (0.0284 vs 0.0139)

answers.q1_formula_and_direction: Both Stage3 evaluate and 18d OOS use realized/predicted. Stage3 vol_calibration_ratio = E_i[realized_i/pred_i] from teacher-forced mixture expected_path_vol. 18d calibration_ratio_realized_over_predicted = E_i[realized_i/predicted_i] from free-AR uniform path vols. Same direction; opposite over/under only because pred magnitudes differ.
answers.q2_shared_and_different: Shared: denorm close, daily returns from cumulative, path vol = std over H=10 of daily returns, ddof=0, lookback=120, T/top_p/N lock values. Different: teacher-forced independent-horizon top-N stitching + mixture weights (Stage3) vs free AR coherent samples + uniform mean (18d); Stage3 also applies nucleus to joint logp at T=1 after T-scaled s1/s2; Stage3 selects top-N deterministically rather than multinomial sampling.
answers.q3_population: No. Realized path vol is ~0.0242 (causal val) vs ~0.0249 (18d); cannot flip 0.93->2.10. Predicted path vol is ~2.04x higher on Stage3 proxy.
answers.q4_uniform_vs_mixture_smoking_gun: NOT the smoking gun for the direction flip. Smoke: pred≈0.028, uniform≈0.034, mixture_mean≈0.024, realized≈0.024 → ratios ~0.93 / ~0.71 / ~0.99 all still <=1 (over-vol or calibrated). Switching Stage3 to uniform would make over-vol WORSE. 18d already uses the uniform aggregator and still gets pred≈0.014 (under-vol). The flip requires the free-AR vs teacher-forced-pseudo-path difference.
answers.q5_smallest_next_experiment: See recommended_next_step: paired dual-proxy diagnostic on SAME windows; design-only; no GPU launch now.

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.claim: Stage3 'production decode' proxy is NOT free AR. It builds pseudo-paths by stitching independently ranked top-N joint tokens across horizons under teacher forcing, which inflates day-to-day return std (~0.028). Sealed 18d uses true auto_regressive_inference samples whose concentrated T/top_p paths are under-dispersed (~0.014). Same nominal T/top_p/N; different generative object.
Even at same T/top_p, Stage3 takes deterministic top-N from the nucleus; 18d multinomial-samples. Top-N extremes stretch path diversity further on the teacher-forced surface.
Mixture weighting pulls Stage3 pred (0.028) below uniform (0.034) toward realized, but cannot explain 18d under-vol. Ruling this out as primary.
Different windows could change absolute vols, but realized match (~0.975x) falsifies population-alone flip.
Both report E[R/P]. Jensen gap exists (Stage3 0.93 vs 0.85; 18d 2.10 vs 1.79) but does not change over vs under.

recommended_next_step.title: paired_dual_proxy_vol_diagnostic_design_only
recommended_next_step.compute: future_single_GPU_preferred; CPU acceptable for tiny N if overnight OK
recommended_next_step.goal: On the SAME fixed windows and C2-best checkpoint, compute Stage3 teacher-forced mixture metrics and free-AR OOS-style metrics side-by-side to confirm proxy mismatch without training.

window_sets: A: stratified sample of causal val (e.g. 512-2048 windows)
B: optional 1-2 sealed signal dates from 18d panel (small; do not re-seal or retune)
protocol.success_criterion: If on set A, stage3 ratio stays <1 (~0.9) while free_ar ratio stays >1 (~2), proxy mismatch is confirmed and population is ruled out. Then fix the TRAINING PROXY (replace teacher-forced stitch with a differentiable or stop-grad free-AR / teacher-forced-but-coherent path estimator) before any 40-60 segment vol train.

recommended_next_step.alternative_even_smaller: Pure offline algebra check already done (this report). Next empirical step must compare both proxies on identical tensors; reading more JSON will not resolve remaining uncertainty about magnitude on sealed dates.

verdict_zh_facts: Stage3因果验证与18天OOS的vol_calibration_ratio方向定义相同，均为realized/pred（<1过波动、>1欠波动）。两边都是denorm后对路径日收益做std（H=10、ddof=0），realized几乎一样（~0.0242 vs ~0.0249），但预测波动差约2.04倍（Stage3 pred≈0.0284，18d pred≈0.0139），因此分别得到~0.93与~2.10。根因不是聚合器（uniform反而更过波动）也不是样本总体，而是Stage3所谓production decode仍是teacher-forced、按horizon独立top-N拼出的伪路径+混合权重，而18d是真正的自回归自由采样路径；名义T/top_p/N相同，生成对象不同。下一步应做同窗口双代理诊断（设计已就绪，勿现在开GPU/加长训）。
